items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm Bill Russell. I work at Tulane University.

ctx.x: Well, just a little bit about your husband if you don't mind. Tell us a little bit about him. I'm Bill Russell. I work at Tulane University. We collect the material for Tulane in the library to try and preserve this old history, you know, about the musicians. You want to sit down there a minute?
Who used to play with him, huh?
